prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 团队周报看板（第 34 周） (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 7 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "成员" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 46px
  col 2: header "状态" · longest unbreakable word 19px · one-line width 54px
  col 3: header "本周完成" · longest unbreakable word 58px · one-line width 679px
  col 4: header "下周计划" · longest unbreakable word 44px · one-line width 934px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"汇总团队成员第 34 周的工作状态、本周完成情况和下周计划，便于识别风险与跟进事项。","reading":"读者先按成员定位一行，再查看状态，并横向对照本周完成与下周计划；也可纵向扫描状态列，快速发现风险和阻塞。两列长文本会形成较高的行，同一行内较短单元格可利用已有高度。","groups":["成员和状态共同构成每行的快速识别区。","本周完成和下周计划都是按成员组织的叙述性工作信息，应便于横向比较；下周计划的最长单行内容更长。"],"keep_intact":["成员姓名和状态标记及文字尽量保持在一行，便于快速识别。","数字、百分比、英文术语和其他不可断开的标识应保持完整。","四列表头尽量各占一行。"],"may_wrap":["本周完成和下周计划中的中文叙述可在自然断点换行。","较短叙述可利用同一行中较长叙述形成的高度。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r2A: widths [67, 75, 100, 117] · table 360×1441px · row heights [36, 246, 246, 269, 222, 222, 199] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 11 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2B: widths [67, 75, 102, 115] · table 360×1441px · row heights [36, 246, 246, 269, 222, 222, 199] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 11 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2C: widths [67, 75, 97, 120] · table 360×1580px · row heights [36, 246, 292, 269, 269, 222, 246] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 12 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r2A","good":"成员姓名、状态标记和四列表头均保持单行；两列叙述能够逐行对照，数字和英文术语没有出现词中断裂。","problems":"本周完成列的中文短语经常被切成很短的片段；下周计划列仍有多处长段落，造成高行和较多空白，尤其是阻塞事项所在行。","cause":"前两列占用142px后，两列叙述只有100px和117px；本周完成列扣除内边距后仅有79px文本宽度。"},{"design":"r2B","good":"识别区和表头清晰，词中无断裂；与r2A相比，本周完成列略宽，两列仍保持可辨的横向对应。","problems":"整体行高与r2A相同，2px的调整没有消除主要拥挤；下周计划列仍形成多行密集文本，而较短的同一行单元格下方留有空白。","cause":"102px和115px的分配仍使两列文本区域很窄，且2px变化不足以显著改变决定行高的换行。"},{"design":"r2C","good":"下周计划列较宽，部分计划读起来更连贯；姓名、状态和表头仍保持单行，没有词中断裂。","problems":"本周完成列断行明显更频繁，若干行变高，叙述列之间的高度和空白更不均衡，横向比较更费力。","cause":"本周完成列缩至97px，文本宽度只有76px，跨过了多处换行阈值；下周计划增至120px带来的收益不足以抵消这些增高。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"balanced-105","widths":[67,75,105,112],"change":"以r2B为基础，把3px从下周计划移给本周完成，测试能否减少完成情况的零碎断行，同时保留计划列较宽的优势。"},{"name":"balanced-110","widths":[67,75,110,107],"change":"进一步向本周完成列倾斜，测试较接近均衡的叙述列宽是否能改善行内对照和整体换行。"},{"name":"plan-116","widths":[67,75,101,116],"change":"在r2A和r2B之间微调1px，寻找同时保留本周完成列换行表现和下周计划列可读性的宽度阈值。"}]}
